scientific_question: Does exact goal-dependent probabilistic state reduction leave an acquisition or execution gap against the strongest tested native portfolio, under equal reuse rights?
hypothesis: A free goal-preserving quotient may leave a >=10x opportunity for new requests after strong native optimizations; repeated compiled requests may remove that opportunity.
data_rights: Public QVBS opened-development, CC-BY 4.0; original author attribution retained in metadata. No sealed inputs.
source_selection: Frozen cost-blind 13 requests, 9 model families, 11 JANI files; smallest metadata size in each fixed bin. Equivalent formats/repeats are not independent problems.
candidate_limit: Existing G0 A only; B unchanged. This is no third candidate.
native_input_rights: Both JANI and original PRISM, whenever supported. Coupon original PGCL compiler absent, explicitly JANI-only.
native_version: stormpy 1.14.0, official binary wheel, source d22615ca859f1518015c065414dd0a36c4615484
runtime: Existing free Kaggle CPU4, Python3.13.15/Linux x86_64. No GPU, paid execution or model forwards.
measurement_conditions: First output including process startup and import
Resident process, newly rebuilt original request
Same compiled quotient actually solved again by both arms
free_arm: Native-produced exact quotient is provided in memory; no answer cache. Discovery, delivery and certificate costs omitted only for explicit optimistic floor. Startup is charged in the cold floor.
correctness: All original initial-state outputs, including max over initial states, exact Fraction comparison with public parent-only reference. Exact native checking; reward accumulation preprocessing. No Oracle reference passed to worker.
certificate_trust: Existing Storm strong bisimulation implementation and exact model checker. No new independent quotient proof checker. Reference equality is not a general mathematical certificate.
route_order: Deterministic family-index rotation; both input formats receive the same portfolio. No route picked after its first result.
failure_policy: Preserve every failure/partial/timeout. Wrong original goal stops execution. Unsupported route stops that route, no rescue rerun. Global budget preserves remaining jobs as unexecuted. Completed-subset aggregates never turn incomplete cohort into PASS.
diagnostic_positive_rule: Only a family with both fixed size bins, all original-correct receipts and >=10x geometric optimistic new-request advantage can be flagged POTENTIAL_HEADROOM. It still requires delivery/certification and stronger missing comparators before any G1 admission.
diagnostic_negative_rule: If even optimistic floors fail 10x against the fastest exact native path, HOLD that tested representation/condition. Structural state reduction alone cannot override this.
uncertainty: Three repeats estimate CPU timing variability, not a broad statistical generalization claim. Failure and missing native paths qualify the strongest-comparator claim.
protected_state: NorthStar/Q1-Q7, historical Q34PASS/Q5FAIL/M106FAIL/D2FAIL and sealed Decision3 unchanged
